name: Kolvex FilterMask FM-9 Particulate Half
description:
A no-frills half-face respirator from Kolvex Industrial Supply, the FM-9 is the standard mask on every Circuit factory floor and transit maintenance corridor. Matte charcoal elastomer body, dual side-mounted grey filter cartridges, and a tight-sealing foam inner gasket. The nose bridge is reinforced with a thin aluminum strip for shaping to fit. Strap is a wide neoprene-analog band.

Most worn FM-9s are decorated with marker tags, sticker residue, or paint overspray from the wearer's job site — an accidental archive of everywhere they've worked.
functionality: Filters fine particulates, chemical vapors, and acid-rain aerosols. Cartridges are rated for 40-hour replacement cycles and are widely available at Circuit supply depots. Clip-tab system allows one-hand cartridge swap.
what_it_says: You work somewhere the air will hurt you, and you've made your peace with it.
story_hooks: A batch of counterfeit FM-9 cartridges is circulating in Circuit — they look identical but filter nothing; someone is making money while workers get sick.
A specific lot number of FM-9s was issued to workers at a facility that officially never existed; finding one is a thread that unravels a corponation cover-up.
A Circuit organizer uses the FM-9's standard issue status as a disguise — every face looks the same when you're all wearing Kolvex.
